pyar explore
usage: pyar explore [-h] --formula FORMULA --pop POP seed_file monomer_file

Generate geometries based on formula.

positional arguments:
  seed_file          XYZ file for the seed monomer.
  monomer_file       XYZ file for the monomer.

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --formula FORMULA  Target formula, e.g., C5H4.
  --pop POP          Number of geometries to generate.

pyar trial
usage: python -m pyar [-h] -N n [-i FILE FILE] [--charge CHARGE]
                      [--distance-scaling x.x] [--plot] [-best BEST BEST |
                      --make-configurations | --make-composite |
                      -make-sphere MAKE_SPHERE]

Generate trial directions and trial molecular orientations.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  -N n                  Number of trial directions/orientations to generate.
  -i FILE FILE
  --charge CHARGE
  --distance-scaling x.x
  --plot
  -best BEST BEST
  --make-configurations
  --make-composite
  -make-sphere MAKE_SPHERE

pyar mlopt

                  input_molecule final_molecule

Optimize a molecule using a specified model.

positional arguments:
  input_molecule        the path to the input molecule file
  final_molecule        the path to the final molecule file

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  -c, --charge CHARGE   the charge of the molecule
  -m, --multiplicity MULTIPLICITY
                        the multiplicity of the molecule

pyar conformer
usage: pyar conformer [-h] [--input-format {auto,smiles,sdf,mol,xyz}]
                      [--num-conformers NUM_CONFORMERS] [--top-n TOP_N]
                      [--backend-top-n BACKEND_TOP_N] [--num-seeds NUM_SEEDS]
                      [--diversity-fraction DIVERSITY_FRACTION]
                      [--compactness-fraction COMPACTNESS_FRACTION]
                      [--rms-threshold RMS_THRESHOLD]
                      [--use-random-coords | --no-use-random-coords]
                      [--torsion-kicks | --no-torsion-kicks]
                      [--torsion-mode {random}]
                      [--torsion-rounds TORSION_ROUNDS]
                      [--torsion-kicks-per-conformer TORSION_KICKS_PER_CONFORMER]
                      [--torsion-max-bonds TORSION_MAX_BONDS]
                      [--torsion-dedup-rms TORSION_DEDUP_RMS]
                      [--dedup-atom-mode {heavy,all}]
                      [--force-field {auto,mmff,uff}] [--seed SEED]
                      [--num-threads NUM_THREADS]
                      [--max-iterations MAX_ITERATIONS] [-c CHARGE]
                      [-m MULTIPLICITY] [--scftype SCFTYPE]
                      [--backend BACKEND]
                      [--geometry-optimizer {native,geometric}]
                      [--method METHOD] [--basis BASIS] [--model MODEL]
                      [--gxtb-wrapper GXTB_WRAPPER]
                      [--custom-keywords CUSTOM_KEYWORDS]
                      [--scf-threshold SCF_THRESHOLD]
                      [--xtb-model {gfn2,gxtb}]
                      [--opt-threshold {loose,normal,tight}] [--nprocs NPROCS]
                      [--opt-cycles OPT_CYCLES] [--scf-cycles SCF_CYCLES]
                      [--check] [--profile NAME] [--write-config FILE]
                      [--dry-run] [--json] [-v] [-q] [--no-color]
                      input

Generate and optionally refine RDKit conformers.

positional arguments:
  input                 SMILES string, SDF/MOL file, or XYZ file

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --input-format {auto,smiles,sdf,mol,xyz}
                        Input format; auto treats existing .xyz/.sdf/.mol
                        paths as files and other input as SMILES.
  --num-conformers NUM_CONFORMERS
  --top-n TOP_N
  --backend-top-n BACKEND_TOP_N
  --force-field {auto,mmff,uff}
  --backend BACKEND     Optional backend refinement; omit for geometry-only
                        generation
  --check               Validate without embedding or creating a run directory

Advanced generation controls:
  --num-seeds NUM_SEEDS
  --diversity-fraction DIVERSITY_FRACTION
  --compactness-fraction COMPACTNESS_FRACTION
                        Protected contact-rich folded-basin quota; matched by
                        an open-basin quota for diversity.
  --rms-threshold, --prune-rms-threshold RMS_THRESHOLD
                        RDKit greedy prune RMS threshold; lower values keep
                        more embedded conformers.
  --use-random-coords, --no-use-random-coords
                        Start RDKit embedding from random coordinates instead
                        of distance geometry eigenvectors.
  --torsion-kicks, --no-torsion-kicks
                        Generate local torsion-perturbed conformers before
                        backend refinement.
  --torsion-mode {random}
                        Use the stratified random torsion-kick sampler.
  --torsion-rounds TORSION_ROUNDS
  --torsion-kicks-per-conformer TORSION_KICKS_PER_CONFORMER
  --torsion-max-bonds TORSION_MAX_BONDS
  --torsion-dedup-rms TORSION_DEDUP_RMS
  --dedup-atom-mode {heavy,all}
                        Atoms scored by shared graph RMSD; full connectivity
                        is always checked.
  --seed SEED
  --num-threads NUM_THREADS
  --max-iterations MAX_ITERATIONS

molecule:
  -c, --charge CHARGE
  -m, --multiplicity MULTIPLICITY
  --scftype SCFTYPE

Backend optimization overrides:
  --geometry-optimizer {native,geometric}
  --method METHOD
  --basis BASIS
  --model MODEL
  --gxtb-wrapper GXTB_WRAPPER
  --custom-keywords CUSTOM_KEYWORDS
  --scf-threshold SCF_THRESHOLD
  --xtb-model {gfn2,gxtb}
  --opt-threshold {loose,normal,tight}
  --nprocs NPROCS
  --opt-cycles OPT_CYCLES
  --scf-cycles SCF_CYCLES

Common execution controls:
  --profile NAME        Apply methodology settings; explicit CLI values win
  --write-config FILE   Save a validated configuration (refuses existing
                        files)
  --dry-run             Preflight and display the resolved execution plan
  --json                Emit a structured request/result; progress goes to
                        stderr
  -v, --verbose         Increase detail (-vv/-vvv for diagnostics)
  -q, --quiet           Suppress workflow progress; preserve primary analysis
                        data
  --no-color            Plain output (currently the default)

pyar aggregate
usage: pyar aggregate [-h] [--size SIZE [SIZE ...]] [--formula FORMULA]
                      [--backend BACKEND]
                      [--geometry-optimizer {native,geometric}]
                      [--method METHOD] [--basis BASIS] [--model MODEL]
                      [--gxtb-wrapper GXTB_WRAPPER]
                      [--custom-keywords CUSTOM_KEYWORDS]
                      [--scf-threshold SCF_THRESHOLD]
                      [--xtb-model {gfn2,gxtb}]
                      [--opt-threshold {loose,normal,tight}] [--nprocs NPROCS]
                      [--opt-cycles OPT_CYCLES] [--scf-cycles SCF_CYCLES]
                      [--charge CHARGE [CHARGE ...]]
                      [--multiplicity MULTIPLICITY [MULTIPLICITY ...]]
                      [--scftype {rhf,uhf} [{rhf,uhf} ...]]
                      [--orientations ORIENTATIONS]
                      [--maximum-number-of-seeds MAXIMUM_NUMBER_OF_SEEDS]
                      [--connectivity-policy {auto,off,prefer,strict}]
                      [--selection-feature SELECTION_FEATURE]
                      [--selection-algorithm SELECTION_ALGORITHM]
                      [--selection-distance SELECTION_DISTANCE]
                      [--selection-system-type SELECTION_SYSTEM_TYPE]
                      [--site I J] [--check]
                      [--number-of-pathways NUMBER_OF_PATHWAYS]
                      [--recover-stale-lock] [--first-pathway FIRST_PATHWAY]
                      [--profile NAME] [--write-config FILE] [--dry-run]
                      [--json] [-v] [-q] [--no-color]
                      [inputs ...]

positional arguments:
  inputs                XYZ files or existing element/formula input
                        specifications

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --size, --aggregate-size SIZE [SIZE ...]
  --formula FORMULA     Expand a composition formula into atomic building
                        blocks, not bonds
  --backend BACKEND     Optional backend refinement; omit for geometry-only
                        generation
  --charge CHARGE [CHARGE ...]
  --multiplicity MULTIPLICITY [MULTIPLICITY ...]
  --scftype {rhf,uhf} [{rhf,uhf} ...]
  --orientations, -N ORIENTATIONS
  --maximum-number-of-seeds MAXIMUM_NUMBER_OF_SEEDS
  --connectivity-policy {auto,off,prefer,strict}
  --selection-feature SELECTION_FEATURE
  --selection-algorithm SELECTION_ALGORITHM
  --selection-distance SELECTION_DISTANCE
  --selection-system-type SELECTION_SYSTEM_TYPE
  --site I J            0-based sites in the original seed and incoming
                        fragment (grow)
  --check               Read-only validation; generate no structures
  --number-of-pathways NUMBER_OF_PATHWAYS
  --recover-stale-lock  Explicit stale v2 writer recovery; never breaks an
                        active lock
  --first-pathway FIRST_PATHWAY

Backend optimization overrides:
  --geometry-optimizer {native,geometric}
  --method METHOD
  --basis BASIS
  --model MODEL
  --gxtb-wrapper GXTB_WRAPPER
  --custom-keywords CUSTOM_KEYWORDS
  --scf-threshold SCF_THRESHOLD
  --xtb-model {gfn2,gxtb}
  --opt-threshold {loose,normal,tight}
  --nprocs NPROCS
  --opt-cycles OPT_CYCLES
  --scf-cycles SCF_CYCLES

Common execution controls:
  --profile NAME        Apply methodology settings; explicit CLI values win
  --write-config FILE   Save a validated configuration (refuses existing
                        files)
  --dry-run             Preflight and display the resolved execution plan
  --json                Emit a structured request/result; progress goes to
                        stderr
  -v, --verbose         Increase detail (-vv/-vvv for diagnostics)
  -q, --quiet           Suppress workflow progress; preserve primary analysis
                        data
  --no-color            Plain output (currently the default)

pyar grow
usage: pyar grow [-h] --count COUNT [--backend BACKEND]
                 [--geometry-optimizer {native,geometric}] [--method METHOD]
                 [--basis BASIS] [--model MODEL] [--gxtb-wrapper GXTB_WRAPPER]
                 [--custom-keywords CUSTOM_KEYWORDS]
                 [--scf-threshold SCF_THRESHOLD] [--xtb-model {gfn2,gxtb}]
                 [--opt-threshold {loose,normal,tight}] [--nprocs NPROCS]
                 [--opt-cycles OPT_CYCLES] [--scf-cycles SCF_CYCLES]
                 [--charge CHARGE [CHARGE ...]]
                 [--multiplicity MULTIPLICITY [MULTIPLICITY ...]]
                 [--scftype {rhf,uhf} [{rhf,uhf} ...]]
                 [--orientations ORIENTATIONS]
                 [--maximum-number-of-seeds MAXIMUM_NUMBER_OF_SEEDS]
                 [--connectivity-policy {auto,off,prefer,strict}]
                 [--selection-feature SELECTION_FEATURE]
                 [--selection-algorithm SELECTION_ALGORITHM]
                 [--selection-distance SELECTION_DISTANCE]
                 [--selection-system-type SELECTION_SYSTEM_TYPE] [--site I J]
                 [--check] [--output OUTPUT] [--recover-stale-lock]

                 seed monomer

  --connectivity-policy {auto,off,prefer,strict}
  --selection-feature SELECTION_FEATURE

  --selection-system-type SELECTION_SYSTEM_TYPE

                        fragment (grow)

pyar microsolvate
usage: pyar microsolvate [-h] --count COUNT [--backend BACKEND]
                         [--geometry-optimizer {native,geometric}]
                         [--method METHOD] [--basis BASIS] [--model MODEL]
                         [--gxtb-wrapper GXTB_WRAPPER]
                         [--custom-keywords CUSTOM_KEYWORDS]
                         [--scf-threshold SCF_THRESHOLD]
                         [--xtb-model {gfn2,gxtb}]
                         [--opt-threshold {loose,normal,tight}]
                         [--nprocs NPROCS] [--opt-cycles OPT_CYCLES]
                         [--scf-cycles SCF_CYCLES]
                         [--charge CHARGE [CHARGE ...]]
                         [--multiplicity MULTIPLICITY [MULTIPLICITY ...]]
                         [--scftype {rhf,uhf} [{rhf,uhf} ...]]
                         [--orientations ORIENTATIONS]
                         [--maximum-number-of-seeds MAXIMUM_NUMBER_OF_SEEDS]
                         [--site ATOM [ATOM ...]]
                         [--site-group NAME=ATOM[,ATOM...]]
                         [--contact-distance CONTACT_DISTANCE]
                         [--surface-points-per-atom SURFACE_POINTS_PER_ATOM]
                         [--probe-radius PROBE_RADIUS]
                         [--shell-tolerance SHELL_TOLERANCE]
                         [--objective {shell,cluster}]
                         [--wall {none,outer-sphere,auto}]
                         [--wall-radius WALL_RADIUS]
                         [--wall-force-constant WALL_FORCE_CONSTANT]
                         [--placement-score {geometric,energy}]
                         [--resampling-moves RESAMPLING_MOVES]
                         [--resampling-evaluation-budget RESAMPLING_EVALUATION_BUDGET]
                         [--resampling-time-limit RESAMPLING_TIME_LIMIT]
                         [--resampling-seed RESAMPLING_SEED] [--output OUTPUT]
                         [--recover-stale-lock] [--check] [--profile NAME]
                         [--write-config FILE] [--dry-run] [--json] [-v] [-q]
                         [--no-color]
                         solute solvent

Build a bounded explicit solvent ensemble around the original solute surface.

positional arguments:
  solute                Original solute XYZ; remains the placement target
  solvent               One solvent XYZ molecule to add repeatedly

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --count COUNT         Number of solvent molecules to add
  --backend BACKEND     Optional backend refinement; omit for geometry-only
                        generation
  --charge CHARGE [CHARGE ...]
  --multiplicity MULTIPLICITY [MULTIPLICITY ...]
  --scftype {rhf,uhf} [{rhf,uhf} ...]
  --orientations, -N ORIENTATIONS
  --maximum-number-of-seeds MAXIMUM_NUMBER_OF_SEEDS
  --site ATOM [ATOM ...]
                        0-based original-solute atom(s) whose accessible
                        surface is targeted
  --site-group NAME=ATOM[,ATOM...]
                        Opt-in post-optimization contact group, e.g. donor=2,5
                        (repeatable)
  --contact-distance CONTACT_DISTANCE
                        Explicit atom-pair contact cutoff in Angstrom;
                        required with --site-group
  --surface-points-per-atom SURFACE_POINTS_PER_ATOM
                        Deterministic Fibonacci samples per solute atom
  --probe-radius PROBE_RADIUS
                        Probe expansion in Angstrom for the discretized vdW
                        placement surface
  --shell-tolerance SHELL_TOLERANCE
                        Maximum solvent-centre distance from the target
                        surface after relaxation (Angstrom)
  --objective {shell,cluster}
                        shell preserves surface coverage; cluster searches
                        fixed-composition low-energy aggregates
  --wall {none,outer-sphere,auto}
                        wall mode: none, explicit outer-sphere, or auto after
                        an unbiased shell escape
  --wall-radius WALL_RADIUS
                        outer-sphere radius in Angstrom; required with --wall
                        outer-sphere (not auto)
  --wall-force-constant WALL_FORCE_CONSTANT
                        harmonic wall strength in hartree/Angstrom^2; required
                        with --wall outer-sphere (not auto)
  --placement-score {geometric,energy}
                        Candidate selection basis; energy requires backend
                        optimization (Hartree)
  --resampling-moves RESAMPLING_MOVES
                        Opt in to bounded whole-cluster perturbation after
                        growth (0 disables MS4)
  --resampling-evaluation-budget RESAMPLING_EVALUATION_BUDGET
                        Maximum physical backend energy/gradient evaluations
                        for MS4
  --resampling-time-limit RESAMPLING_TIME_LIMIT
                        Maximum MS4 wall time in seconds
  --resampling-seed RESAMPLING_SEED
                        Reproducible MS4 proposal seed
  --output OUTPUT
  --recover-stale-lock  Explicit stale v2 writer recovery; cannot break an
                        active lock
  --check               Validate request and preflight without creating files

Backend optimization overrides:
  --geometry-optimizer {native,geometric}
  --method METHOD
  --basis BASIS
  --model MODEL
  --gxtb-wrapper GXTB_WRAPPER
  --custom-keywords CUSTOM_KEYWORDS
  --scf-threshold SCF_THRESHOLD
  --xtb-model {gfn2,gxtb}
  --opt-threshold {loose,normal,tight}
  --nprocs NPROCS
  --opt-cycles OPT_CYCLES
  --scf-cycles SCF_CYCLES

Common execution controls:
  --profile NAME        Apply methodology settings; explicit CLI values win
  --write-config FILE   Save a validated configuration (refuses existing
                        files)
  --dry-run             Preflight and display the resolved execution plan
  --json                Emit a structured request/result; progress goes to
                        stderr
  -v, --verbose         Increase detail (-vv/-vvv for diagnostics)
  -q, --quiet           Suppress workflow progress; preserve primary analysis
                        data
  --no-color            Plain output (currently the default)

pyar neb
usage: pyar neb [-h] (--ts-guess TS_GUESS | --path-seed PATH_SEED)
                --backend BACKEND [--method METHOD] [--basis BASIS]
                [--xtb-model {gfn2,gxtb}] [--charge CHARGE]
                [--multiplicity MULTIPLICITY] [--nprocs NPROCS]
                [--output OUTPUT] [--check] [--images IMAGES]
                [--interpolation {linear,idpp,geodesic}]
                [--path-refinement {none,idpp,geodesic}]
                [--path-seed-maximum-frame-index PATH_SEED_MAXIMUM_FRAME_INDEX]
                [--max-cycles MAX_CYCLES] [--max-gradient MAX_GRADIENT]
                [--average-gradient AVERAGE_GRADIENT] [--spring SPRING]
                [--climb CLIMB] [--align] [--profile NAME]
                [--write-config FILE] [--dry-run] [--json] [-v] [-q]
                [--no-color]
                start end

Run a validated geomeTRIC reaction-path search between endpoint structures.

positional arguments:
  start
  end

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --ts-guess TS_GUESS   Initial waypoint geometry for the path
  --path-seed PATH_SEED
                        Multi-frame XYZ seed for NEB initialization
  --backend BACKEND
  --method METHOD
  --basis BASIS
  --xtb-model {gfn2,gxtb}
  --charge CHARGE
  --multiplicity MULTIPLICITY
                        Infer singlet/doublet from electron parity when
                        omitted
  --nprocs NPROCS
  --output OUTPUT
  --check

Advanced stage controls:
  --images IMAGES
  --interpolation {linear,idpp,geodesic}
  --path-refinement {none,idpp,geodesic}
                        Whole-path refinement used with --path-seed
  --path-seed-maximum-frame-index PATH_SEED_MAXIMUM_FRAME_INDEX
                        Optional constrained-scan maximum frame index for
                        provenance
  --max-cycles MAX_CYCLES
  --max-gradient MAX_GRADIENT
  --average-gradient AVERAGE_GRADIENT
  --spring SPRING
  --climb CLIMB
  --align

Common execution controls:
  --profile NAME        Apply methodology settings; explicit CLI values win
  --write-config FILE   Save a validated configuration (refuses existing
                        files)
  --dry-run             Preflight and display the resolved execution plan
  --json                Emit a structured request/result; progress goes to
                        stderr
  -v, --verbose         Increase detail (-vv/-vvv for diagnostics)
  -q, --quiet           Suppress workflow progress; preserve primary analysis
                        data
  --no-color            Plain output (currently the default)

pyar ts
usage: pyar ts [-h] --backend BACKEND [--method METHOD] [--basis BASIS]
               [--xtb-model {gfn2,gxtb}] [--charge CHARGE]
               [--multiplicity MULTIPLICITY] [--nprocs NPROCS]
               [--output OUTPUT] [--check] [--ts-optimizer {geometric,sella}]
               [--ts-max-cycles TS_MAX_CYCLES] [--ts-fmax TS_FMAX]
               [--sella-fmax SELLA_FMAX] [--sella-internal-coordinates]
               [--profile NAME] [--write-config FILE] [--dry-run] [--json]
               [-v] [-q] [--no-color]
               geometry

Optimize and validate a transition-state geometry.

  geometry              Initial TS guess geometry

  --method METHOD
  --basis BASIS
  --xtb-model {gfn2,gxtb}

                        Infer singlet/doublet from electron parity when
                        omitted
  --nprocs NPROCS
  --output OUTPUT
  --check

  --sella-fmax SELLA_FMAX

  --write-config FILE   Save a validated configuration (refuses existing
                        files)
  --dry-run             Preflight and display the resolved execution plan
  --json                Emit a structured request/result; progress goes to

pyar react
usage: pyar react [-h] [--backend BACKEND] [--bias-max BIAS_MAX]
                  [--orientations ORIENTATIONS] [--charge CHARGE [CHARGE ...]]
                  [--multiplicity MULTIPLICITY [MULTIPLICITY ...]]
                  [--through {react,neb,ts,frequency,irc,endpoints,endpoint-frequency,all}]
                  [--reactant-reference-mode {minima,separated-reactants}]
                  [--bias-potential {afir,softmin}]
                  [--bias-controller {adaptive,fixed,scheduled}]
                  [--recover-stale-lock] [--check] [--bias-min BIAS_MIN]
                  [--softmin-beta SOFTMIN_BETA]
                  [--geometry-optimizer {geometric,native}] [--site I J]
                  [--proximity-factor PROXIMITY_FACTOR]
                  [--pathway-ts-source {highest-backend-energy,first-topology-change,pre-product,highest-total-energy}]
                  [--xtb-model {gfn2,gxtb}]
                  [--scftype {rhf,uhf} [{rhf,uhf} ...]] [--method METHOD]
                  [--basis BASIS] [--opt-threshold OPT_THRESHOLD]
                  [--nprocs NPROCS] [--opt-cycles OPT_CYCLES]
                  [--scf-cycles SCF_CYCLES]
                  [--release-retry-limit RELEASE_RETRY_LIMIT]
                  [--bias-alpha-min BIAS_ALPHA_MIN]
                  [--bias-alpha-margin BIAS_ALPHA_MARGIN]
                  [--bias-alpha-smoothing BIAS_ALPHA_SMOOTHING]
                  [--bias-alpha-epsilon BIAS_ALPHA_EPSILON]
                  [--bias-scheduled-alpha BIAS_SCHEDULED_ALPHA]
                  [--release-margin-factor RELEASE_MARGIN_FACTOR]
                  [--release-distance-fraction RELEASE_DISTANCE_FRACTION]
                  [--images IMAGES] [--neb-max-cycles MAX_CYCLES]
                  [--max-gradient MAX_GRADIENT]
                  [--average-gradient AVERAGE_GRADIENT] [--spring SPRING]
                  [--climb CLIMB] [--interpolation {linear,idpp,geodesic}]
                  [--idpp-fmax IDPP_FMAX] [--idpp-steps IDPP_STEPS]
                  [--geodesic-tol GEODESIC_TOL]
                  [--geodesic-max-iter GEODESIC_MAX_ITER]
                  [--product-relaxation-fmax PRODUCT_RELAXATION_FMAX]
                  [--product-relaxation-max-steps PRODUCT_RELAXATION_MAX_STEPS]
                  [--ts-max-cycles TS_MAX_CYCLES] [--ts-fmax TS_FMAX]
                  [--sella-fmax SELLA_FMAX] [--irc-max-cycles IRC_MAX_CYCLES]
                  [--endpoint-max-cycles ENDPOINT_MAX_CYCLES]
                  [--imaginary-frequency-threshold IMAGINARY_FREQUENCY_THRESHOLD]
                  [--irc-endpoint-rmsd-tolerance IRC_ENDPOINT_RMSD_TOLERANCE]
                  [--ts-optimizer {geometric,sella}] [--align | --no-align]
                  [--sella-internal-coordinates | --no-sella-internal-coordinates]
                  [--profile NAME] [--write-config FILE] [--dry-run] [--json]
                  [-v] [-q] [--no-color]
                  XYZ XYZ

reaction interface; the canonical workflow owns all reaction science.

positional arguments:
  XYZ

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --backend BACKEND     Explicit physical energy/gradient backend
  --bias-max BIAS_MAX   Required scientific bias ceiling (kJ/mol)
  --orientations, -N ORIENTATIONS
                        Trial orientations (default: 8)
  --charge CHARGE [CHARGE ...]
  --multiplicity MULTIPLICITY [MULTIPLICITY ...]
  --through {react,neb,ts,frequency,irc,endpoints,endpoint-frequency,all}
                        Continue each unique product through unbiased path
                        validation (default: react only)
  --reactant-reference-mode {minima,separated-reactants}
                        Reactant-side energy and IRC reference policy
  --bias-potential {afir,softmin}
                        Default: afir
  --bias-controller {adaptive,fixed,scheduled}
                        Default: adaptive
  --recover-stale-lock  Explicit stale v2 writer recovery; never breaks an
                        active lock
  --check               Validate both phases and restart; run no calculations

Advanced reaction/backend overrides:
  --bias-min BIAS_MIN   Required for fixed/scheduled; ignored for adaptive
  --softmin-beta SOFTMIN_BETA
  --geometry-optimizer {geometric,native}
  --site I J            0-based fragment-local atom index in A and B
  --proximity-factor PROXIMITY_FACTOR
  --pathway-ts-source {highest-backend-energy,first-topology-change,pre-product,highest-total-energy}
                        Trace geometry used only as a NEB waypoint/TS guess
  --xtb-model {gfn2,gxtb}
  --scftype {rhf,uhf} [{rhf,uhf} ...]
  --method METHOD
  --basis BASIS
  --opt-threshold OPT_THRESHOLD
  --nprocs NPROCS
  --opt-cycles OPT_CYCLES
  --scf-cycles SCF_CYCLES
  --release-retry-limit RELEASE_RETRY_LIMIT
  --bias-alpha-min BIAS_ALPHA_MIN
  --bias-alpha-margin BIAS_ALPHA_MARGIN
  --bias-alpha-smoothing BIAS_ALPHA_SMOOTHING
  --bias-alpha-epsilon BIAS_ALPHA_EPSILON
  --bias-scheduled-alpha BIAS_SCHEDULED_ALPHA
  --release-margin-factor RELEASE_MARGIN_FACTOR
  --release-distance-fraction RELEASE_DISTANCE_FRACTION

Advanced unbiased path continuation options:
  --images IMAGES
  --neb-max-cycles, --max-cycles MAX_CYCLES
  --max-gradient MAX_GRADIENT
  --average-gradient AVERAGE_GRADIENT
  --spring SPRING
  --climb CLIMB
  --interpolation {linear,idpp,geodesic}
  --idpp-fmax IDPP_FMAX
  --idpp-steps IDPP_STEPS
  --geodesic-tol GEODESIC_TOL
  --geodesic-max-iter GEODESIC_MAX_ITER
  --product-relaxation-fmax PRODUCT_RELAXATION_FMAX
  --product-relaxation-max-steps PRODUCT_RELAXATION_MAX_STEPS
  --ts-max-cycles TS_MAX_CYCLES
  --ts-fmax TS_FMAX
  --sella-fmax SELLA_FMAX
  --irc-max-cycles IRC_MAX_CYCLES
  --endpoint-max-cycles ENDPOINT_MAX_CYCLES
  --imaginary-frequency-threshold IMAGINARY_FREQUENCY_THRESHOLD
  --irc-endpoint-rmsd-tolerance IRC_ENDPOINT_RMSD_TOLERANCE
  --ts-optimizer {geometric,sella}
  --align, --no-align
  --sella-internal-coordinates, --no-sella-internal-coordinates

  --max-gradient MAX_GRADIENT
                        Stationarity maximum per-atom gradient, Eh/bohr
  --rms-gradient RMS_GRADIENT
                        Stationarity RMS per-atom gradient, Eh/bohr
  --imaginary-threshold IMAGINARY_THRESHOLD
                        Significant imaginary frequency magnitude, cm^-1
                        (default: 20)

Common execution controls:
  --profile NAME        Apply methodology settings; explicit CLI values win
  --write-config FILE   Save a validated configuration (refuses existing
                        files)
  --dry-run             Preflight and display the resolved execution plan
  --json                Emit a structured request/result; progress goes to
                        stderr
  -v, --verbose         Increase detail (-vv/-vvv for diagnostics)
  -q, --quiet           Suppress workflow progress; preserve primary analysis
                        data
  --no-color            Plain output (currently the default)

pyar optimize
usage: pyar optimize [-h] [--backend BACKEND] [--check]
                     [--recovery {off,safe,guided}]
                     [--recovery-max-attempts RECOVERY_MAX_ATTEMPTS]
                     [--recovery-max-cycles RECOVERY_MAX_CYCLES]
                     [--recovery-max-evaluations RECOVERY_MAX_EVALUATIONS]

                        Opt-in bounded recovery; guided may reset the
                        geomeTRIC trust model (default: off)
  --recovery-max-attempts RECOVERY_MAX_ATTEMPTS

  --recovery-wall-seconds RECOVERY_WALL_SECONDS

pyar scan-bond
usage: pyar scan-bond [-h] --atoms I J [-N ORIENTATIONS]
                      [--backend {xtb,aimnet_2,orca,gaussian}] [--check]
                      [--method METHOD] [--xtb-model {gxtb,gfn2}]
                      [--basis BASIS] [--gxtb-wrapper GXTB_WRAPPER]
                      [--nprocs NPROCS] [--scf-cycles SCF_CYCLES]
                      [--opt-cycles OPT_CYCLES]
                      [--opt-threshold {loose,normal,tight}]
                      [--scan-end SCAN_END] [--scan-step SCAN_STEP |
                      --scan-points SCAN_POINTS] [-c CHARGE [CHARGE ...]]
                      [-m MULTIPLICITY [MULTIPLICITY ...]]
                      [--total-multiplicity TOTAL_MULTIPLICITY]
                      [--scftype SCFTYPE [SCFTYPE ...]] [--output OUTPUT]
                      [--recover-stale-lock]
                      [--through {scan,neb,ts,frequency,irc,endpoints,endpoint-frequency,all}]
                      [--characterize-unique-products] [--images IMAGES]
                      [--neb-max-cycles MAX_CYCLES]
                      [--max-gradient MAX_GRADIENT]
                      [--average-gradient AVERAGE_GRADIENT] [--spring SPRING]
                      [--climb CLIMB] [--align]

                      [--idpp-fmax IDPP_FMAX] [--idpp-steps IDPP_STEPS]
                      [--geodesic-tol GEODESIC_TOL]

                      [--product-relaxation-max-steps PRODUCT_RELAXATION_MAX_STEPS]

                      [--irc-max-cycles IRC_MAX_CYCLES]
                      [--endpoint-max-cycles ENDPOINT_MAX_CYCLES]
                      [--imaginary-frequency-threshold IMAGINARY_FREQUENCY_THRESHOLD]
                      [--irc-endpoint-rmsd-tolerance IRC_ENDPOINT_RMSD_TOLERANCE]
                      [--profile NAME] [--write-config FILE] [--dry-run]
                      [--json] [-v] [-q] [--no-color]
                      XYZ [XYZ ...]

Relaxed bond scan with optional NEB, TS, frequency, IRC and endpoint
validation.

positional arguments:
  XYZ                   one molecule for an intramolecular scan, or fragment A
                        and B XYZ files

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --atoms I J           0-based atom indices in the molecule, or local to
                        fragments A and B
  -N, --orientations ORIENTATIONS
  --backend {xtb,aimnet_2,orca,gaussian}
  --check               Validate the complete requested path without
                        calculation
  --method METHOD       electronic-structure method (ORCA default: BP86)
  --xtb-model {gxtb,gfn2}
                        standalone xTB model (default: gfn2)
  --basis BASIS         basis set; required for DFT methods, not used by xTB
                        methods
  --gxtb-wrapper GXTB_WRAPPER
                        executable ORCA external-method wrapper (oet_gxtb) for
                        --method g-xTB
  --nprocs NPROCS
  --scf-cycles SCF_CYCLES
  --opt-cycles OPT_CYCLES
  --opt-threshold {loose,normal,tight}
  --scan-end SCAN_END
  --scan-step SCAN_STEP
  --scan-points SCAN_POINTS
  -c, --charge CHARGE [CHARGE ...]
  -m, --multiplicity MULTIPLICITY [MULTIPLICITY ...]
  --total-multiplicity TOTAL_MULTIPLICITY
                        total multiplicity of the combined A+B system
                        (defaults to the historical coupling heuristic)
  --scftype SCFTYPE [SCFTYPE ...]
  --output OUTPUT
  --recover-stale-lock  Explicit stale v2 writer recovery; never breaks an
                        active lock
  --through {scan,neb,ts,frequency,irc,endpoints,endpoint-frequency,all}
                        last stage to execute; all includes endpoint
                        frequencies (default: scan)
  --characterize-unique-products
                        after scan and free relaxation, run one scan-seeded
                        path per unique product
  --images IMAGES
  --neb-max-cycles MAX_CYCLES
  --max-gradient MAX_GRADIENT
  --average-gradient AVERAGE_GRADIENT
  --spring SPRING
  --climb CLIMB
  --align
  --interpolation {linear,idpp,geodesic}
  --idpp-fmax IDPP_FMAX
  --idpp-steps IDPP_STEPS
  --geodesic-tol GEODESIC_TOL
  --geodesic-max-iter GEODESIC_MAX_ITER
  --product-relaxation-fmax PRODUCT_RELAXATION_FMAX
  --product-relaxation-max-steps PRODUCT_RELAXATION_MAX_STEPS
  --ts-optimizer {geometric,sella}
  --ts-max-cycles TS_MAX_CYCLES
  --ts-fmax TS_FMAX
  --sella-fmax SELLA_FMAX
  --sella-internal-coordinates
  --irc-max-cycles IRC_MAX_CYCLES
  --endpoint-max-cycles ENDPOINT_MAX_CYCLES
  --imaginary-frequency-threshold IMAGINARY_FREQUENCY_THRESHOLD
  --irc-endpoint-rmsd-tolerance IRC_ENDPOINT_RMSD_TOLERANCE

pyar benchmark conformer
usage: pyar benchmark conformer [-h] [--num-conformers NUM_CONFORMERS]
                                [--num-seeds NUM_SEEDS] [--top-n TOP_N]
                                [--backend-top-n BACKEND_TOP_N]
                                [--rms-hit-threshold RMS_HIT_THRESHOLD]
                                [--energy-window ENERGY_WINDOW]
                                [--output OUTPUT]
                                [--diversity-fraction DIVERSITY_FRACTION]
                                [--compactness-fraction COMPACTNESS_FRACTION]
                                [--rms-threshold RMS_THRESHOLD]
                                [--use-random-coords | --no-use-random-coords]
                                [--torsion-kicks | --no-torsion-kicks]
                                [--torsion-rounds TORSION_ROUNDS]
                                [--torsion-mode {random}]
                                [--torsion-kicks-per-conformer TORSION_KICKS_PER_CONFORMER]
                                [--torsion-max-bonds TORSION_MAX_BONDS]
                                [--torsion-dedup-rms TORSION_DEDUP_RMS]
                                [--dedup-atom-mode {heavy,all}]
                                [--force-field {auto,mmff,uff}] [--seed SEED]
                                [--num-threads NUM_THREADS]
                                [--max-iterations MAX_ITERATIONS]
                                [--software {gaussian,mopac,obabel,orca,psi4,turbomole,xtb,xtb_turbo,mlatom_aiqm1,aimnet_2,aiqm1_mlatom,xtb-aimnet2,xtb-aiqm1}]
                                [--geometry-optimizer {native,geometric}]
                                [--opt-target {minimum,ts}] [-basis BASIS]
                                [-method METHOD]
                                [--opt-threshold OPT_THRESHOLD]
                                [--opt-cycles OPT_CYCLES]
                                [--scf-threshold SCF_THRESHOLD]
                                [--scf-cycles SCF_CYCLES] [-nprocs NPROCS]
                                [--custom-keywords CUSTOM_KEYWORDS]
                                [-model MODEL]
                                benchmark

Benchmark pyar-conformer and classify missed-reference causes.

positional arguments:
  benchmark             JSON conformer benchmark specification

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --num-conformers NUM_CONFORMERS
  --num-seeds NUM_SEEDS
  --top-n TOP_N
  --backend-top-n BACKEND_TOP_N
  --rms-hit-threshold RMS_HIT_THRESHOLD
  --energy-window ENERGY_WINDOW
                        Classify reference-like generated conformers outside
                        this RDKit native force-field energy window as
                        wrong_ranking.
  --output OUTPUT

conformer search:
  --diversity-fraction DIVERSITY_FRACTION
  --compactness-fraction COMPACTNESS_FRACTION
                        Protected contact-rich folded-basin quota; matched by
                        an open-basin quota for diversity.
  --rms-threshold RMS_THRESHOLD
  --use-random-coords, --no-use-random-coords
  --torsion-kicks, --no-torsion-kicks
  --torsion-rounds TORSION_ROUNDS
  --torsion-mode {random}
                        Use the stratified random torsion-kick sampler.
  --torsion-kicks-per-conformer TORSION_KICKS_PER_CONFORMER
  --torsion-max-bonds TORSION_MAX_BONDS
  --torsion-dedup-rms TORSION_DEDUP_RMS
  --dedup-atom-mode {heavy,all}
                        Atoms scored by shared graph RMSD; full connectivity
                        is always checked.
  --force-field {auto,mmff,uff}
  --seed SEED
  --num-threads NUM_THREADS
  --max-iterations MAX_ITERATIONS

backend refinement:
  --software {gaussian,mopac,obabel,orca,psi4,turbomole,xtb,xtb_turbo,mlatom_aiqm1,aimnet_2,aiqm1_mlatom,xtb-aimnet2,xtb-aiqm1}
  --geometry-optimizer {native,geometric}
  --opt-target {minimum,ts}
  -basis, --basis BASIS
  -method, --method METHOD
  --opt-threshold OPT_THRESHOLD
  --opt-cycles OPT_CYCLES
  --scf-threshold SCF_THRESHOLD
  --scf-cycles SCF_CYCLES
  -nprocs, --nprocs NPROCS
  --custom-keywords CUSTOM_KEYWORDS
  -model, --model MODEL

pyar benchmark orientations
usage: python -m pyar [-h] [-N NUMBER_OF_POINTS [NUMBER_OF_POINTS ...]]
                      [-m {random,lhs,lhs_maximin,fibonacci,fibonacci_maximin} [{random,lhs,lhs_maximin,fibonacci,fibonacci_maximin} ...]]
                      [-r REPEAT] [--evaluation-points EVALUATION_POINTS]
                      [--oversample-factor OVERSAMPLE_FACTOR]

Benchmark direction samplers for trial geometry generation.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  -N, --number-of-points NUMBER_OF_POINTS [NUMBER_OF_POINTS ...]
                        Numbers of direction samples to benchmark.
  -m, --methods {random,lhs,lhs_maximin,fibonacci,fibonacci_maximin} [{random,lhs,lhs_maximin,fibonacci,fibonacci_maximin} ...]
                        Sampling methods to compare.
  -r, --repeat REPEAT   Repeats for randomized methods; deterministic methods
                        repeat identically.
  --evaluation-points EVALUATION_POINTS
                        Dense reference directions used to approximate
                        covering radius.
  --oversample-factor OVERSAMPLE_FACTOR
                        Candidate-pool multiplier for maximin methods.

pyar benchmark ts
usage: pyar benchmark ts [-h] {run,collect,prepare-rgd1} ...

Run or collect paired PyAR transition-state optimizer benchmarks.

positional arguments:
  {run,collect,prepare-rgd1}
    run                 run one independently scheduled case/optimizer job
    collect             collect complete and incomplete paired jobs
    prepare-rgd1        create a small manifest from an extracted RGD1-TSopt-
                        GFN2 dataset

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
